modmenu.descriptionTranslation.iqclauth: Fabric dual-side mod: client RSA-OAEP encrypts PIN, server transparently forwards to remote verifier and performs Ed25519 signature verification. Also supports server-side password login (PBKDF2 hash + multiple storage backends).
iqclauth.auth.blocked: You are not logged in, cannot perform this action
iqclauth.auth.kick: Login timed out, please re-enter PIN
iqclauth.auth.pin_invalid: Invalid PIN format, expected ABCD-EFGH-JKLM (12 uppercase alphanumeric chars with hyphens)
iqclauth.password.error.no_special: Password must contain a special character
iqclauth.password.error.weak: Password is too weak, avoid common weak passwords
iqclauth.password.error.confirm_mismatch: The two passwords do not match
iqclauth.password.error.already_register: You have already registered a password account, please login directly or use /iqcl changepassword
iqclauth.password.error.not_registered: You have not registered a password account
iqclauth.password.error.same_password: New password must differ from the old one
iqclauth.password.error.storage_unavaila: Password login service is unavailable, please retry later or contact admin
iqclauth.password.register.success: Password account registered, use /iqcl login password <password> to login
iqclauth.password.admin.unregistered: Player's password account has been deleted
